name: user-card
title: User Card
description: User profile card with avatar and info.

files.content:
export { UserCard } from './UserCard'
export type { UserStat, UserCardProps } from './user-card.types'

import type React from 'react'

export interface UserStat {
  label: string
  value: string | number
}

export interface UserCardProps {
  name: string
  username?: string
  bio?: string
  avatar?: string
  avatarFallback?: string
  stats?: UserStat[]
  badge?: string
  followed?: boolean
  onFollow?: (followed: boolean) => void
  coverColor?: string
  className?: string
  style?: React.CSSProperties
}
